title: Validation Gate Hygiene: Ruff Clean and CI Alignment with React v2
goal: Bring the repository's local validation and GitHub CI gates back into alignment with the active backend, worker, and React v2 release lanes.
scope: Ruff cleanup, CI workflow validation steps, React v2 install/build/test wiring, and testing policy consistency.
generation_reason: Review-time validation found python compile and selected tests passing, but ruff failed on reports.py and a worker test import. The GitHub CI workflow also still runs legacy ui/tests smoke checks rather than the React v2 active browser gate described in TESTING_POLICY.md.

review_findings: .venv/bin/ruff check api/app workers scripts failed on reports.py E702 and test_idor_bac_runner.py F401
.github/workflows/ci.yml does not run ui-v2 npm build/test:e2e/lint
TESTING_POLICY.md names React v2 Playwright as the active browser release gate

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Focus on validation hygiene and CI gate alignment. Do not refactor reporting semantics, runner behavior, or UI features.
constraints.no_force_dependency_upgrades: Do not run npm audit fix --force or introduce breaking dependency upgrades unless a separate task explicitly approves it.

success_criteria: Ruff passes for api/app, workers, and scripts without suppressing the reported issues unnecessarily.
GitHub CI runs backlog validation, Python compile, ruff, backend/worker/script tests, and React v2 install/build/lint/Playwright checks aligned with TESTING_POLICY.md.
Legacy /app/ UI tests remain diagnostic-only unless explicitly reactivated by a future task.
CI workflow uses reproducible npm install behavior through package-lock.json.
Documentation states the active release gates accurately.

acceptance_criteria: The exact ruff failures found in the review are resolved.
CI reflects the active React v2 browser release lane rather than relying on retired legacy smoke tests as a release gate.
No functional runtime, scanning, approval, scope, credential, or finding-schema changes are introduced.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the single active task.
after_completion: Promote the next true open task into NEXT_TASK.md, or record that no active backlog task remains in NEXT_TASK.md.

out_of_scope: Changing report content or management-report narrative behavior beyond lint-safe formatting.
Adding new tests for unrelated product features.
Performing major dependency upgrades or npm audit force fixes.
Changing runner execution, approval gates, or runtime binding.
